title: Preloaded dependency can still be misattributed to later on-disk bytes
cause: LOADED_PRODUCERS captures a dependency file at owner-operator import time, not necessarily when that dependency module was imported. An already cached dependency retains its original function/class objects after its file changes. The new owner import records the newer file as the loaded dependency and accepts matching plan pins.
reproduction: Fresh private process imports native publication_guard first, changes only its private file, then imports frozen new owner operator. owner.FrozenFile is the already imported class. prepare/dry-run accepts while reported loaded guard hash82c34680 differs from its captured actual import-source hashf6d1e625.
required_fix: Ensure the dependency execution is freshly bound to verified captured bytes or reject preloaded/unprovable implementations. Capturing a cached module file later is insufficient. Preserve existing globals used by native consumers and do not silently reload unrelated shared modules. A bounded private subprocess with verified inputs is one possible design, but implementation choice belongs to the author.
scope: Same existing1195 finding, no new issue needed. Private dry-run only; no author/maintained edits.
